thread:
Alex (AE): Hey team — Verdant scheduled an initial sync for their trial tomorrow at 10am PT. They want to align success criteria and surface any enterprise blockers. Can SEs + security join?
Maria (SE): I'm in. Can we confirm scope: classification API for care triage + embeddings for search?
Alex (AE): Yep, primary use case: triage classification (multi-label), secondary: semantic search over notes. They want a 2-week trial with a small eval set.
Ravi (Security): Need to know if they'll require VPC/private deployment or just hosted with SOC2 assurances. Any contractual SSO/KMS asks?
Claire (Verdant): Hi all — we'll be using internal PHI-like data, so we need VPC + customer-managed KMS, and a security questionnaire backfilled. Also need data retention policy details.
Maria (SE): Ok noted. For trial we can offer a scoped hosted sandbox with encrypted-at-rest + option to do Private if they escalate. SE ask: expected QPS and typical prompt lengths?
Claire (Verdant): Peak QPS ~20, average prompt size ~120 tokens, responses ~180 tokens. p95 latency target ~200ms.
Jon (Product): Add quality success metric: >88% F1 on their annotated eval set (1000 examples) and no significant regressions vs baseline. Also define cost target: <$300 per 100k inference tokens.
Maria (SE): Drafted minimal eval plan: 1) 1k annotated prompts; 2) A/B model comparison (quantized v float); 3) automated evaluation harness + manual review on 50 samples. Snippet of eval prompt examples:
```
Prompt: "Given clinical note, tag urgent follow-up? [yes/no]"
Expected: "yes"
```
Alex (AE): Pricing question from procurement: Will trial usage convert to Reserved Dedicated pricing, and can we provide a 3-month pilot discount?
Ravi (Security): For the security questionnaire, I'll send our standard answers. Need to confirm: do they require on-prem air-gapped install or just VPC? Also list of approved IP ranges and SOC2 report requested.
Claire (Verdant): We'll start with VPC. On-prem only if scale requires. Can you share an expected timeline?
Alex (AE): Proposed timeline: Day0 access + data ingest (3 days), Day4 model tuning & initial eval, Day8 mid-trial review, Day14 final evaluation + decision. Can ops and SE confirm we can meet Day0 access w/ current infra?
Maria (SE): Should be fine if Verdant provides sample data + network allowlist by EOD today. I'll prepare canary config and prompt set.
Jon (Product): Blockers: billing approval for trial > certain spend, and legal NDA for transfer of eval data.
Ravi (Security): I'll attach the questionnaire & the VPC onboarding checklist after this thread.
Alex (AE): Thanks — I'll update Verdant and share invites. Action items: Maria prepare eval harness; Ravi send security docs; Jon shortlist model variants; Claire to share eval set and allowlist.
ops-bot: reminder: create trial environment for verdant (id: verdant-2087) — ETA 2h :gear:
